title: Research provenance
description: provenance.json: who did each role on one dossier, on which model and effort, in which session. The same record onRails's research skill writes (research-provenance/1), plus a session for every role. A value nobody recorded is "unknown", never a guess. scripts/check.mjs enforces this.

dossier.description: The dossier's file, next to this record.

stores.description: Every dossier has the desk store. Add measurements when it holds runs.

model.description: The exact model ID the session reports, not a marketing name. "human" when a person did the role by hand.

harness.description: The tool and version, and whether it ran as a subagent. "none" for a person.

session.description: The session's ID as the tool reports it, a short label you make up when the tool shows none ("fact-check subagent 1"), or unknown. The fact-check's session must differ from the author's.

brief.description: Path to the committed brief, relative to the dossier folder, or unknown.

requested.description: What the agent that started this role asked for. When it differs from model or effort, notes says why.

disposition.description: fact-check only: the file where each finding is fixed, disputed or accepted.
